name: Acolytes of Plague
text: You must recruit a Pox Priest to lead your warband. You begin the campaign with the Desecrated Chapel stronghold. Your warband can include 0-2 Pox Priest Apprentices.

name: Rooftop Runners
text: You must recruit a Nightfang Assassin to lead your warband. You begin the campaign with the Hidden Vantage stronghold.

name: Sparkseer Coven
text: You must hire a Sparkseer to lead your warband. You begin the campaign with the Rickety Workshop stronghold. Your warband can include 0-2 Rolling Contraptions.

name: Merciless Tyrant
text: You must recruit an Ironfang Warlord to lead your warband. You begin the campaign with the Fortified Warren stronghold.
